$comment: Every icon the product uses, and where it comes from in Figma.
`url` is a Figma asset URL and EXPIRES IN ABOUT SEVEN DAYS — it is a fetch
token, not a permanent address. Refresh it with download_assets(nodeId,
defaultFormat:'svg') before re-running the importer. The committed .tsx
files are the durable artefact; this file records provenance.
`nodeId` is the ICON VARIANT node, not the instance on a screen. Where a
glyph appears in a nav item the id is the `Size=20px, Weight=1px` variant;
in a 32px control it is the 16px variant. Colour variants (Neutral vs
Primary) are the same paths and the importer rewrites stroke to
currentColor, so only one of the pair is ever listed.
`size` is Figma's Size variant (16, 20 or 32 — this library has no 24) and
`weight` is its Weight variant in pixels (1 or 2, default 1). Both are the
DRAWN values, not targets: the icon renders at the weight Figma gives it.
